title: An improved protocol to establish experimental tuberculous meningitis in the rabbit
author: O'Brien, Vinnard, et al.

steps.title: Day‑1 screw implantation
steps.instruction: Under anesthesia (ketamine 0.5 ml/kg IM and xylazine 3.5 ml/kg IM), attach four aluminum screws (0.5 × 2 in) to the skull: place each screw about 1 mm outer to the cranial vertex and 2 mm lateral to the sagittal suture over the frontal, parietal and occipital cortex; secure a half‑turnbuckle helmet with Dura Base dental acrylic; position the mask for later stereotactic fixation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare ketamine (0.5 ml/kg) and xylazine (3.5 ml/kg) and inject intramuscularly.
Expose the skull and drill pilot holes; insert four aluminum screws (0.5 × 2 in) at the specified locations.
Apply Dura Base dental acrylic to attach a half‑turnbuckle helmet over the screws.
Fit the mask so the animal can be positioned in a stereotactic frame.

steps.title: Day‑2 intracisternal inoculation (original)
steps.instruction: Sedate the rabbit again with ketamine 0.5 ml/kg IM and xylazine 3.5 ml/kg IM, fix the head in a stereotactic frame using a machine bolt (0.25 × 4 in), insert a 3.5 × 25 G spinal needle into the cisterna magna, and inject 0.3 ml of bacterial suspension containing ≈5 × 10⁵ CFU.

substeps.instruction: Administer the same ketamine/xylazine mixture intramuscularly.
Secure the animal’s head in the stereotactic frame with the 0.25 × 4 in machine bolt.
Insert a 3.5 × 25 G spinal needle into the cisterna magna.

steps.title: Sample collection post‑infection
steps.instruction: At predefined time points after inoculation, collect cerebrospinal fluid and blood samples for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Improved protocol – adapter fixation
steps.instruction: Replace the screw‑helmet assembly with a stereotactic‑frame adapter that holds the rabbit’s head firmly; perform a single sedation (ketamine 0.5 ml/kg and xylazine 3.5 ml/kg IM) and proceed directly to intracisternal injection as in the original inoculation step, thereby eliminating the day‑1 surgery and reducing animal stress.

substeps.instruction: Attach the head‑holding adapter to the stereotactic frame (no screws or acrylic helmet).
Sedate the rabbit once with ketamine 0.5 ml/kg IM and xylazine 3.5 ml/kg IM.
Insert the 3.5 × 25 G spinal needle into the cisterna magna and inject 0.3 ml of inoculum (~5 × 10⁵ CFU).
